supersedes.reason: That conclusion's causal_validation.decision was TAE_TECHNICALLY_BLOCKED because both models failed the source_activation_reproduction gate before a complete response surface existed. The technical blocker is now resolved (root cause: non-deterministic GPU kernel execution, compounded by a padded-batch vs. unpadded-baseline numerical discrepancy in intervention batching, both fixed; see docs/development_log.md and docs/sealed_prediction_20260823.md for the full diagnostic trail). A complete, gate-clean causal run now exists for both models. This conclusion reports its result; it does not edit or retract the prior document, which remains an accurate record of the earlier, genuinely blocked state.

conclusion: The determinism-patched, batch-one v3 causal run completed cleanly for both models with zero source_activation_reproduction gate violations across 163,200 records each (max_abs=0.0, min_cosine=0.9999998807907104 in both, versus the frozen max_abs<=0.125/cosine>=0.999 gate). The frozen, single-shot analysis (scripts/analyze_pilot80_factorial_causal.py, run exactly once) returned decision="negative": the purpose-by-format interaction (C) and its dose-response and additivity properties pass cleanly and consistently in both models, but the shared-purpose (A) and format (B) main effects fail the frozen criterion because it additionally requires significance at each model's deliberately low-interaction control layer, where the two models each narrowly miss for different reasons.

criteria_detail.endpoint_valid: One readout (8B purpose_casual) has ROC AUC=0.776, below the required 0.80 baseline_gate threshold; all four other model/endpoint combinations pass (8B format 1.0, 8B purpose_benchmark 0.825, 70B format 1.0, 70B purpose_benchmark 0.830, 70B purpose_casual 0.803).
criteria_detail.A_shared: At the high-interaction layer, large and clean in both models (8B layer 29: point=1.159, 95% CI [1.142,1.177], random-control p=0.030; 70B layer 74: point=1.026, CI [1.015,1.037], p=0.030). At the low-interaction control layer, tiny and fails the conjunctive requirement in 8B (layer 5: point=0.0125, CI excludes zero but random-control p=0.091, above the 0.05 bar); passes at 70B's control layer (layer 13: point=0.00765, p=0.030).
criteria_detail.B_format: Large and clean at both high-interaction layers (8B layer 29: point=0.110, p=0.030; 70B layer 74: point=0.109, p=0.030). Fails at both control layers, for different reasons: 8B layer 5 point=0.00069 with p=0.212 (too weak); 70B layer 13 point=-0.00055, wrong sign.
criteria_detail.C_interaction: Gated only on the high-interaction layer per the frozen criterion; passes cleanly in both models (8B layer 29: point=0.469, CI [0.459,0.478], p=0.030; 70B layer 74: point=0.783, CI [0.772,0.795], p=0.030).
criteria_detail.dose_response: Alpha=0.5 vs alpha=1.0 for C: near-perfect linear scaling in both models and both signs (ratios 0.498-0.503 against a theoretical 0.5).
criteria_detail.factorial_cube_agreement: Additive R^2 = 0.9986 (8B) and 0.9976 (70B) against the required >0.50 threshold; the eight-corner cube response is almost perfectly predicted by the sum of the three single-component effects despite the A/C direction vectors not being orthogonal (see geometry note below).

geometry_context.note: Offline, activation-geometry-only analyses (never touching causal readout scores, computed both before and alongside the causal run) found cos(A,C) ~= -0.56 at 8B's high-interaction layer and ~= -0.32 at 70B's, i.e. the fitted purpose (A) and interaction (C) direction vectors are not orthogonal. This geometric overlap does not translate into non-additive causal effects (factorial_cube_agreement passes near-perfectly): additivity of injected perturbations is governed by local linearity of the network's response to the vector sum of interventions, not by orthogonality of the injected directions. A generic-text-fitted Jacobian (zero purpose/format content) predicts the real purpose and format readout directions far above a random-direction null (z up to 39 at 8B layer 24), most strongly in the back half of the network; this generic-channel alignment does not track linear decodability (which is high from very early layers in both models), so the two properties are structurally independent.
geometry_context.not_used_for_inference: This geometry work informed a sealed, falsifiable prediction (docs/sealed_prediction_20260823.md) written before the 70B run completed. Two of its highest-confidence predictions (A_shared, B_format both PASS) were wrong; the prediction it was least confident about mechanistically (factorial_cube_agreement FAIL) was also wrong. The resolution is recorded in that file and is not treated as independent confirmation of anything reported here.

allowed: A validated, format-decorrelated, cross-model-replicated causal effect of the purpose x format interaction (C) on internal purpose readouts, at the high-interaction layer, in both an 8B and a 70B model
Near-perfectly linear dose-response of that interaction effect with intervention strength
Near-perfect additivity of the eight-corner factorial cube despite non-orthogonal injected directions
A documented, resolved technical root cause (non-deterministic GPU execution plus a padded-batch numerical discrepancy) for the prior gate failure
A negative result for the full frozen shared-purpose (A) and format (B) main-effect criteria, specifically failing at the deliberately low-interaction control layers
prohibited: A clean positive causal A/B/C mechanism (A_shared and B_format did not pass)
Behavioral steering (behavioral_secondary endpoint was never run; no generation/task-accuracy data exists for this run)
A universal model mechanism or causal scaling law from two data points
Independent confirmation (the sealed prediction was informed by informal peeks at partial 8B data during the same session, not an independent replication)
Best-layer or best-alpha post-hoc selection (both explicitly forbidden by the frozen protocol's own prohibited_claims list)

sprint_stop_condition.reason: This assay runs the canonical matched factorial geometry plus a controlled intervention to completion under the frozen, prospectively-declared gate and analysis pipeline, with zero post-outcome adaptation. The frozen decision is negative for the primary main-effect criteria (A_shared, B_format), positive for the interaction criterion (C_interaction) and its dose-response and additivity properties. This is a genuine, reportable, mixed result, not a technical block and not a clean uniform negative.
